strategy.overview: Varkon begins on the upper playfield. Complete upper targets 1 through 5 to light the ramp chamber, then make the lit chamber: the upper ball is held and a second ball is served to the lower playfield. When the lower ball drains, the held ball returns to the upper level. Upper 1-5 completions also advance the chamber value; K-O-N advances upper Bonus X, V-A-R raises the jet-bumper value, and the chamber can light the Bull's-Eye for Extra Ball. On the lower level, targets 6 through 10 build bonus and A-B advances its separate multiplier.
strategy.simpleOverview: Complete upper targets 1 through 5 to light the ramp chamber, then shoot the lit chamber to hold the upper ball and start play on the lower level. Complete K-O-N for upper Bonus X. On the lower playfield, complete 6 through 10 for bonus and A-B for its multiplier.
strategy.summary: Qualify the chamber first, use the lower level to build its large bonus safely, then resume the upper ball with K-O-N and the Bull's-Eye route already advanced.

steps.text: Complete upper targets 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 to light the ramp chamber.
Shoot the lit chamber to hold the upper-playfield ball and serve a ball onto the lower playfield.
On the lower level, complete targets 6 through 10 to collect and advance bonus, and hit A and B to raise its multiplier.
After the lower ball drains and the upper ball returns, complete K-O-N for upper Bonus X and continue 1-5 completions to raise the chamber value.

alternatives.title: Bull's-Eye Extra Ball route
alternatives.when: Use this when the ramp chamber value has reached the machine's Extra Ball threshold.

steps.text: Raise the chamber value to 20,000 or more through repeated 1-5 completions.
Make the lit chamber, then hit the lit Bull's-Eye for the configured Extra Ball award.
Complete upper targets 1 through 5 and shoot the lit chamber.
Complete lower targets 6 through 10 and A-B before the lower ball drains.

machineSetup: Check the ramp-chamber value needed to light Bull's-Eye Extra Ball, the maximum lower bonus, both Bonus X ladders, and the Special award.
Test upper targets 1-5, V-A-R rollovers, K-O-N targets, Bull's-Eye, chamber hold and transfer, lower targets 6-10, A-B targets, both flipper sets, and both level drains.

techniques.name: Dead Bounce
techniques.instruction: On the cramped lower level, let a safe return cross to the opposite flipper instead of adding an unnecessary flip before the 6-10 bank shot.

cautions.issue: Varkon's player view is mirrored, so left and right on a service diagram are reversed from the view through the cabinet glass.
cautions.response: Identify shots by their labels and level before using a left/right callout.
